translations.web: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.
translations.bsb: A wicked man listens to evil lips; a liar gives ear to a destructive tongue.
translations.kjv: A wicked doer giveth heed to false lips; and a liar giveth ear to a naughty tongue.
translations.asv: An evil-doer giveth heed to wicked lips; And a liar giveth ear to a mischievous tongue.
